How Massachusetts Bin Stores Work: The Weekly Pricing Model Bin stores in Massachusetts offer incredible savings on brand-name merchandise. These stores purchase overstock inventory, Amazon returns, and liquidated items from major retailers like Target, Walmart, and Home Depot, then pass massive discounts to shoppers. Items typically start at higher prices ($15) on restock days and drop daily until reaching as low as $0 by the end of the week. Most stores follow a weekly pricing model, restock on specific days (usually Friday or Saturday), and maintain active Facebook pages with updates.
